import io,json,os,sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ['WB_SCRIPTS'])
WB = os.environ['WB_HOME']
# 隔离态下往 worktree 外写：shim 必须拒绝
import platform_ops, tempfile
outside = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='wb-outside-')
target = os.path.join(outside, 'escape.txt')
code = ('open(%r, "w").write("x")' % target)
p = platform_ops.spawn_group(
    [sys.executable, '-c', code], cwd=os.path.dirname(WB),
    env={'PYTHONIOENCODING': 'utf-8', 'PATH': os.environ.get('PATH', ''),
         'SYSTEMROOT': os.environ.get('SYSTEMROOT', ''),
         'TEMP': os.environ.get('TEMP', ''), 'TMP': os.environ.get('TMP', ''),
         'WB_ISOLATE': '1', 'WB_WORKTREE': os.path.dirname(WB)},
    stdout=-1, stderr=-1)
out, err = p.communicate(timeout=60)
err_text = (err or b'').decode('utf-8', 'replace')
wrote = os.path.isfile(target)
print('rc=%s wrote_outside=%s' % (p.returncode, wrote))
print('stderr_tail=%r' % err_text[-200:])
print('BYPASS_OK' if wrote else 'BYPASS_BLOCKED')
